industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Sunview Group Bhd
summary: Sunview Group Berhad, along with its various subsidiaries, is a Malaysian firm specializing in the solar energy sector. The company delivers comprehensive solutions for solar photovoltaic (PV) facilities, covering everything from design and procurement to construction, testing, and final setup. Beyond project development, Sunview Group also operates in the generation and distribution of solar power. Additionally, it provides expert solar PV engineering services and supplies necessary PV equipment and supporting systems. The company was founded in 2013 and is based in Petaling Jaya, Malaysia.
